tool.name: Kruskal.wallis
tool.description: Non-parametric test for OTUs that differ between treatments
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$shared' shared.dat && ln -s '$design' design.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #if $label: #silent $mothur_args.append("label=" + str(str($label).replace(",","-"))) #end if #if $class: #silent $mothur_args.append("class=" + str($class)) #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("shared=shared.dat") #silent $mothur_args.append("design=design.dat")
echo 'kruskal.wallis(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.label: design - assign groups to treatments
param.help: design has 2 TAB-separated columns with a 'group' header: group and treatment level

param.label: class - which treatment category to compare
param.help: If not provided the first category of the design file is used

param.name: label
param.label: label - select OTU distance labels
param.help: all labels are used if none are selected

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The kruskal.wallis_ command compares the abundance of each OTU across the treatment levels of a design_ file with the Kruskal-Wallis rank sum test, and reports the test statistic and the p-value for every OTU. Treatments are assigned to the groups of the shared_ file with a design file, which has two TAB-separated columns (`group` and the treatment level) and a header line.
One dataset is written for every label of the shared file requested with the label_ parameter; they are returned as the ``kruskall_wallis`` collection, keyed by label.
.. _kruskal.wallis: https://mothur.org/wiki/kruskal.wallis/ .. _design: https://mothur.org/wiki/design_file/ .. _shared: https://mothur.org/wiki/shared_file/ .. _label: https://mothur.org/wiki/kruskal.wallis/
